rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for deliberate harmful intent or ill will.

example.english: They deliberately hid the problem with the contract to deceive people out of malice.
example.traditional: 佢明知份合約有問題，仲故意隱瞞，真係帶住惡意呃人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ming4 zi1 fan6 hap6 joek3 jau5 man6 tai4 zung6 gu3 ji3 jan2 mun4 zan1 hai6 daai2 zyu6 ok3 ji3 ak1 jan4

rows.note: Use this when the malice is expressed as open hostility toward a person or group, rather than merely a hidden harmful intention.

example.english: The two community representatives immediately started accusing each other, and the room was full of malice.
example.traditional: 兩個社區代表一見面就互相指責，現場充滿敵意。
example.jyutping: loeng5 go3 se5 keoi1 doi6 biu2 jat1 gin3 min6 zau6 wu6 soeng1 zi2 zaak3 jin6 coeng4 cung1 mun5 dik6 ji3

rows.note: Use this for a person's mean-spirited disposition or ill will, especially rather than a specific hostile act.

example.english: They always laugh when other people fail; they really have malice in them.
example.traditional: 佢成日見到人哋失敗就偷笑，真係壞心腸。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gin3 dou2 jan4 dei6 sat1 baai6 zau6 tau1 siu3 zan1 hai6 waai6 sam1 coeng4
